rate_note: AUD only, no conversion. Gowans hammer excludes about 19.8% premium.
viewing_check: Check it is real Huon pine (sweet resinous smell, fine even grain, pale yellow, pin knots) rather than celery top or similar; measure width and thickness of each board; look for rot, splits, shake and borers. Wider (30 cm+) clean boards are the ones that reach $100+.
